notes: Both checks concern reset behaviour, so no disable iff is used. rst_n_q holds the reset level sampled at the previous edge. CHK-012 antecedent: reset low, or reset high for two consecutive edges. Its consequent o_tlul_d_ready == i_rst_n_core gives 0 in reset and 1 afterwards. CHK-013 antecedent: reset low, or the first edge with reset high after a low edge (rst_n_q == 0). Hits count the antecedent. Not compiled or run in Verilator.
